messages:
anya: Heads-up — thinking about adding an "estimated units" column to Embed Routes in the Console. Right now users get 413s w/ oversized arrays and no pre-estimate. Can we show an immediate estimate for (dims, bytes) so devs can fix before hitting quota?

phil: I like it. We already compute an estimate in preflight but it's opt-in via header `X-Embed-Preflight: true`. We could surface `est_units` + `split_plan` from preflight response. Example:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "est_units": 12,
  "split_plan": [ {"chunk_count":2, "dim":768}, {"chunk_count":1, "dim":512} ]
}
```

maria: UX note: don't show raw JSON. Show simple pill: "~12 units — may split into 3 chunks" and a link to a sample request fix. Also indicate confidence band (+/-). :thumbsup:

jamie: runtime question — est_units today assumes compact clients (no padding). For mixed-dims we need per-item dimension detection. That code path is somewhat expensive; can we run a cheap heuristic in preflight and schedule deeper profiling asynchronously?

phil: yes — cheap heuristic: sample 3 vectors per request to guess mixed dims, fallback to full scan if sample variance > threshold. We'll add `est_confidence: low|medium|high`.

anya: great. Also propose console toggle: "Show preflight est for routes" so enterprises can opt out (privacy). Add audit log event if enabled.

maria: also add telemetry: `embed.preflight.estimated_units` metric (tagged by route, tenant_id, confidence). We'll need cardinality guard on tenant_id.

ingest-bot: deploy-bot: preflight-estimator-v1 deployed to staging at 2026-03-20T17:22Z — canary(5%) on eng-platform org.

jamie: Rollout plan: canary + dark launch metrics -> compare predicted units vs actual units (p50/p90 error). If >20% mismatch for more than 1 hour, auto-rollback.

phil: agree. Also add a console chart: predicted vs actual units over 24h. We should forward raw `split_plan` only to internal observability, not to UI to avoid leaking payload shapes.

anya: I'll make a quick mock for Console with the pill + breakdown and a "Fix request" sample in SDKs. Will post mock here by EOD.

maria: thanks. can we add an alert rule: if per-route oversize 413 rate > 0.5% AND predicted_units decreased > 30% (indicates estimator bug) send page to eng-platform? 

phil: yep. will wire into SLO alerts.

anya: awesome. @jamie can you own the canary rollback? @phil wrangle the telemetry tags? I'll own the Console mock.

jamie: I can. will add a playbook. 

ingest-bot: note: test-vector generator available at `https://internal.redwood/testvectors` for synthetic load.

anya: cool, thanks everyone. We'll sync tomorrow 10am to review metrics.
